set.body:
v0.6 IO and AOI milestone. EyeLink support is governed by reliability epic bd-01M039NWZN0BNEDYHVXZFB29CQ rather than a single happy-path fixture.

Exit criteria:
- EyeLink ASC reliability epic is closed with dual-oracle conformance, total diagnostics, cross-platform parity, mutation proof, performance evidence, release validation artifact, and task-first guide.
- CSV ingest, result export, and AOI sequence/transition work are closed.
- A real EDF-derived ASC preserves experiment messages in ObservedTimeline and reaches a downstream scanpath without silent line, eye, time, unit, or provenance loss.
- Synthetic multi-trigger SyncEvidence recovers known offset/drift.
- AoiSet exclusive and multiple-membership accounting laws are green.
- Binary EDF remains outside v0.6; the supported workflow names vendor EDF2ASC explicitly.
